name: Honda India Power Products Limited
summary: Honda India Power Products Limited engages in the manufacture, marketing, and sale of portable generators, water pumps, general purpose engines, lawn mowers, brush cutters, hand tools, portable gensets, tillers, and marine engines in India and internationally. It also markets fishery products comprising long tail outboard motors. In addition, it provides agriculture products, including reapers, HTP sprayers, backpack sprayer, and crop harvester; and ploughs, manure spreaders, seeders, and harrows, as well as other machineries for soil preparation, planting, and fertilizing, harvesting, and threshing; and power weeder.
